source.description:
OPERATOR DIRECTION (2026-08-29 reconciliation; Jira ISSUE-87 comment 12571). Slice 2 (xtrm-eq8, PR #105, squash 3bf4bbe) accepted: trusted ResolvedExecutionContext from chain-runtime scheduler, dry-run provenance canary, self_attested_web classification, no cutover.

SLICE 3 SCOPE (resolve the four residual issues from the Slice 2 independent review before any credential enters the system):
1. REAL NON-PRODUCTION MUTATION ADAPTER: give runProvenanceCanary (src/identity/canary.ts) a real call site against an explicitly designated non-production GitHub/Jira test target, replacing the injectable dry-run fixture as the exercised path. Keep it non-production and reversible; do NOT touch real xtrm-web accounts or connectors.
2. RUNTIME-SESSION IDENTITY CORRECTION: resolve runtime_session_id from StepExecutionState.last_pi_session_id inside src/chain/trusted-context.ts instead of a host-supplied literal, so distinct real runs at the same (participant, attempt) are disambiguated (review F3).
3. ACCOUNT-BINDING ASYMMETRY FIX (review F5, pre-existing): validateMutation must fail when the envelope carries a NON-NULL immutable_account_id while the trusted principal-set config binding is NULL. Currently only the envelope-null-with-cutoverComplete direction is checked.
4. ROLE-BOUND ACTOR OVERRIDE GUARD (review F4): constrain the actorId override in resolveTrustedExecutionContext so the selected registered actor must be associated with the step role; reject any other registered actor. Fine while host-only, but required before a real mutation call site exists.

CANARY SHAPE (once residual 1-4 land):
  real non-production mutation adapter
    -> trusted ResolvedExecutionContext
    -> real runtime_session_id from StepExecutionState
    -> role-bound actor resolution
    -> provenance projection
    -> actual platform object ID
    -> bindPlatformResult
    -> validateMutation
    -> independent receipt verification

GATE BOUNDARY: do NOT perform connector cutover in this slice. Cutover remains a human-only operator action: create the single xtrm-web GitHub/Jira identities, connect Web to them, then run a reversible canary. This slice must NOT create accounts, tokens, Apps, or change connectors.

ACCEPTANCE:
1. Canary exercises a real non-production adapter call site (or documented test-target adapter bound to actual runtime state), not only a pure fixture.
2. runtime_session_id populated from StepExecutionState.last_pi_session_id in the adapter; regression test proves two distinct runs at same attempt get distinct receipts.
3. Non-null envelope account id against null config binding fails closed (test added; cutoverComplete semantics unchanged).
4. actorId override rejected when the actor is not bound to the step role (test added).
5. identity 35/35 + slice2 19/19 + new tests green; typecheck no new errors; git diff --check clean; independent non-author review PASS before merge.
source.notes: PR xtrm-dev/xtrm#106 merged (squash 3fc6922). Reviewed head ad5c5ec; merged tree byte-identical for all 12 changed files. Independent non-author review PASS at ca52227 + delta PASS after symlink-containment remediation (ad5c5ec). Identity 35/35 + slice2 19/19 + slice3 14/14 green; full suite 325 pass / 6 pre-existing environmental beads-adapter failures (ENOSPC spike was full /tmp tmpfs, not code; TMPDIR-on-disk rerun clean). Symlink escape + positive/negative containment tests added. Typecheck 0 errors in touched files. No credentials/accounts/connectors created; canary side effect = local git commit in designated scratch repo only.
